subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Crash Safety of Battery Packs
description: A quick win: understand Crash Safety of Battery Packs.

hook.text: An EV battery stores enough energy to power a house—what happens when that energy is in a crash?

buildup.text: Engineers surround the pack with reinforced steel and aluminum to absorb impact before it reaches the cells.

discovery.text: The pack is the stiffest part of the car, often making EVs structurally safer than combustion vehicles.

twist.text: In some crash tests, EVs score higher than any gas car because the rigid battery stiffens the entire floor.

climax.text: Automatic disconnects cut high-voltage circuits within milliseconds of impact to prevent electrocution.

punchline.text: The heaviest part of an EV is also its strongest safety feature.

quiz.question: How does the battery pack affect EV crash safety?
options: It makes the car less safe
It stiffens the floor and improves structural safety
It has no impact on safety
